definition: Solvent means a liquid that dissolves other substances.
task: Write one sentence of your own using the word solvent. Make the sentence show what the word means -- a reader who did not know solvent should be able to work it out from your sentence.
avoid_verbatim: A drop of eucalyptus solvent lifted the sticker gum from the new picture frame in seconds.
A cleanser lifts dirt off a surface and asks nothing more of chemistry — gentler work than a solvent, which takes the unwanted substance up into itself and carries it away.
An acid goes past a solvent — a solvent carries the varnish away and leaves the wood; an acid eats into the wood itself.

Thinner is the paint counter's solvent, hired for one errand — loosening paint until it flows or lifts. A solvent is the whole class: any liquid that dissolves other substances, water included, whatever the job at hand.

A remover is a solvent sold by its target — polish, glue, stain, the label names what it takes off. Solvent names the liquid's role in general, no target required: whatever it meets, it works by taking the substance up into itself.

Solvent is the exact word for that liquid, because it names a liquid that dissolves other substances — the active partner in the transaction.
Water is the world's commonest solvent, but not the only one, and the cleaner's whole craft is matching the liquid to what must be carried away.
Solvent is the workshop and laboratory noun: the liquid that does the dissolving, from water to paint thinner.
Its mirror in this unit is soluble, which describes the solid being dissolved — one word for each side of the same event.
You will also meet solvent as an adjective meaning able to pay one's debts; that is the same Latin loosening applied to money, and context tells you instantly which one is on the page.

When a museum decides to treat a darkened old painting, no scalpel comes out first — a liquid does.
Conservators work with a graded series of solvents, beginning with ones so mild they barely act and moving up only as the varnish resists.
The goal is a liquid strong enough to take the yellowed varnish up into itself, yet too weak to touch the paint beneath.
